title: Ready Target Reference envelope
$comment: Cross-field invariant enforced by the reference/lifecycle validator: expires_at_unix_ms equals issued_at_unix_ms + 30000 without overflow. A child reference follows Minted -> Redeeming -> Consumed | Expired. Target-only redemption is once while now < expires_at_unix_ms; match-only use is restricted to its already-bound Target-issued session.

target_reference.description: ASCII target_ plus canonical unpadded base64url of exactly 32 bytes; decode then re-encode must be byte-identical.
